record.question: Consider the following statements in connection with boundary relations of electric field: i. In a single medium electric field is continuous. ii. The tangential components are the same on both sides of a boundary between two dielectrics. iii. The tangential electric field at the boundary of a dielectric and a current carrying conductor with finite conductivity is zero. iv. Normal component of the flux density is continuous across the charge-free boundary between two dielectrics. Which of these statements is/are correct?
